name: RUC 65
desc: An enterprise-grade fanless 5G gateway on MediaTek MT7981 with AX3000 Wi-Fi 6, dual-SIM, PoE IN, multi-WAN failover, and robust VPN tunneling. Delivers up to 2.2 Gbps Sub-6 cellular speeds for smart buildings, events, and mission-critical routing.
cpu: MediaTek MT7981 1.3 GHz Dual Core ARM Cortex A53
dims: 105 x 200 x 105 mm (W x H x D)

additional_specs.v: 1 x Gigabit WAN (PoE IN IEEE802.3at), 2 x Gigabit LAN
